transcript: Bhaiya, ek kaam karo, 200 gram paneer dena... uhh nahi ek kaam karo 250 gram kar do. Aur haan, wo jo 40 rupay wala brown bread hai na, uske do packet... wait, ek hi dena kal ka rakha hai. Total kitna hua? Cash de raha hu.
Seth ji, 5 kilo Aashirvaad aatta likhna... aatta chhoro, 10 kilo wala bori de do. Aur usme do packet Tata Salt add kar dena, 25 wala na? Theek hai.
Mujhe teen... nahi chaar liter double toned Amul doodh chahiye. Agar double toned nahi hai toh cow milk de do, par expiry aaj ki nahi honi chahiye.

Dada, ek kilo dedh sau gram (1.150 kg) moong dal pack karna. Rate to 120 tha na? Aur pyaz kya bhaav lagaya? 35 rupay? Theek hai, dhai kilo (2.5 kg) pyaz dalo, aur total bill me chillar round off kar dena.
Sunna bhai, 50-50 gram ke chaar packet haldi de de, aur agar 200 gram ka ek hi packet sasta pad raha hai toh wahi de de. Dono ka rate compare karke bata.
Bhaiya pawan kilo (0.75 kg) kaju dena, wahi pichle baar wala 800 rupay kilo wala. Aur aadha kilo badam, dono ko alag alag pack karke bill ek hi banana.

Seth ji, 50 bori cement likh lo UltraTech ka, rate 380 lagana pichle baar wala. Aur usme loading charges add mat karna, wo ladke main khud bhej raha hu. 18% GST ke sath tax invoice mere WhatsApp pe daal dena.
Hello, mujhe 15 box Classmate notebooks chahiye, A4 size. Har box me 50 piece aate hain na? Rate 32 rupay per piece lagana aur B2B bill banana, main GST number message kar raha hu.
Bhai, 100 kg sugar aur 50 liter Dhara mustard oil dispatch kar do. Oil pe 5% GST lagega na? Aur haan, transport ka bhada bill me include karke total amount batana, RTGS karunga.
Bhai, 5 pieces of Dettol soap, 2 large bottles of Harpic, aur ek 5 kg wala Surf Excel bag dena. Check karna Surf Excel pe koi Diwali promo chal raha hai kya? Agar free bucket hai toh add kar dena.
Scan kar lo sab kuch. Wo buy-one-get-one wala offer Britannia cookies pe apply hua hai ya nahi? Check karna screen pe. Agar nahi hua toh ek packet wapas rakh lo.
Bhaiya iska MRP toh 150 likha hai, aap 165 kyu laga rahe ho? System me price update karo, aur payment main Sodexo ya UPI se karunga, do split me kar sakte ho?
Arre bhaiya pichle bill me aapne Maggi 12 ki jagah 14 ka laga diya tha, wo 20 rupay adjust karna iss baar. Aaj sirf 1 dozen ande aur 2 packet Amul taaza doodh de do. Pura hisaab clear kar do aaj ka.
Kal jo 5 kilo chawal bheja tha wo kharab nikla, usko wapas le lo aur uske badle 65 rupay kilo wala basmati 10 kilo bhej do. Jo difference amount banega wo mere account me likh lena.
Bhaiya ye doodh phata hua nikla subah ka, isko replace kar do. Aur sath me ek 200 MRP wala Cadbury Silk de dena, balance main Google Pay kar raha hu number batao.

Chotu, do kilo cheeni rakh... haan hello? arre call pe hu... haan bhaiya cheeni ho gaya, aur aadha kilo chai patti, Red Label dena. Ruko bhabhi ka call aa raha hai shayad kuch aur add karna hai... haan 2 packet Maggi bhi daal do.
Jaldi bill banana bhaiya gaadi no parking me khadi hai. Sirf ek 5 liter ka Fortune soybean oil aur ek 10 kilo ka India Gate rice, Dubar wala. Phataphat scan karo bag main khud le aya hu.
দাদা, দুই কেজি চাল কেজি ৬০ টাকা আর পাঁচ কেজি ডাল কেজি ১২০ টাকা। সব কিছুর উপর পাঁচ শতাংশ GST যোগ করুন।
ભાઈ, બે કિલો ચોખા 60 રૂપિયા કિલો અને પાંચ કિલો દાળ 120 રૂપિયા કિલો. કુલ પર 5 ટકા GST ઉમેરો.
ಅಣ್ಣಾ, ಎರಡು ಕಿಲೋ ಅಕ್ಕಿ ಕಿಲೋಗೆ 60 ರೂಪಾಯಿ ಮತ್ತು ಐದು ಕಿಲೋ ಬೇಳೆ ಕಿಲೋಗೆ 120 ರೂಪಾಯಿ. ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೇಲೆ 5 ಶೇಕಡಾ GST ಸೇರಿಸಿ.
ചേട്ടാ, രണ്ട് കിലോ അരി കിലോയ്ക്ക് 60 രൂപയും അഞ്ച് കിലോ പരിപ്പ് കിലോയ്ക്ക് 120 രൂപയും. മൊത്തത്തിൽ 5 ശതമാനം GST ചേർക്കുക.
दादा, दोन किलो तांदूळ 60 रुपये किलो आणि पाच किलो डाळ 120 रुपये किलो. एकूण रकमेवर 5 टक्के GST लावा.
ਭਾਜੀ, ਦੋ ਕਿਲੋ ਚੌਲ 60 ਰੁਪਏ ਕਿਲੋ ਅਤੇ ਪੰਜ ਕਿਲੋ ਦਾਲ 120 ਰੁਪਏ ਕਿਲੋ। ਕੁੱਲ ਉੱਤੇ 5 ਫੀਸਦੀ GST ਲਗਾਓ।
அண்ணா, இரண்டு கிலோ அரிசி கிலோ 60 ரூபாய், ஐந்து கிலோ பருப்பு கிலோ 120 ரூபாய். மொத்தத்திற்கு 5 சதவீத GST சேர்க்கவும்.
అన్నా, రెండు కిలోల బియ్యం కిలో 60 రూపాయలు, ఐదు కిలోల పప్పు కిలో 120 రూపాయలు. మొత్తం మీద 5 శాతం GST వేయండి.
